verificationLimits: Chrome and Edge were explicitly attempted but no browser connection was available. Native checks used the ChatGPT in-app browser on this Windows host.

390px viewport coverage is emulation; no physical touchscreen, screen-reader certification or native hidden-page event delivery is claimed. Reduced-motion and frame/timer lifecycle behavior is verified separately in source acceptance.
The complete 180-second timed rehearsal used a passive loopback DOM/input console observer. Production application JavaScript/CSS were unchanged by the observer.

After that run, only inherited crystal-panel text/background CSS was corrected; final source-bound build, contrast, mobile, viewer/fallback and cold-transfer checks were repeated. Tour/runtime/data/export source remained unchanged.
Four actual W6 downloads were freshly collected; three unchanged actual W5 exports were hash-bound and revalidated against current W6 projections.
Earlier interrupted/provisional observations and resolved assertion-scope/timing issues are retained separately and are excluded from final passing counts.
